We liked it very much?
Feb 2024 • Couples
Today is Valentine's Day and we decided to go out for burgers and ribs. A word to all negative writers in advance: we are in Asia, Vietnam to be precise. The clocks/service/spices run a little differently here. That really annoys me. Stay home if you want schnitzel and fries. They are the same people who run to the Chinese restaurant to order pizza.
We were greeted in a friendly manner with a smile and assigned to a table.
A double cheesy hobo burger for me and Canadian ribs for my husband plus a side salad... 1.5 liters of water.
What is unfortunately true is that the service was a bit chaotic. The restaurant was half full but completely overwhelmed. In Asia, people like to share food, so it didn't bother us that my food came first and then my water only came after asking twice. Later came the ribs and I would say that was a good performance for a burger in Vietnam. Yes, the fries were cold and far from crispy. After asking politely, I was given extra perfect fries without any problems. A large portion, even. Destroying my burger was a bit of a hassle because the bottom of my bun was completely soggy. THAT can't happen with frozen food. But it can with freshly made patties. I really enjoyed it.
The highlight were the ribs. It smelled great, the fries were hot/crispy. And it tasted really good. The meat almost fell off the bone, so tender and cooked to perfection. A sign of a kitchen that knows what it's doing.
Moaning about the prices is absolutely tasteless. At home you would have paid 16 euros instead of 6. And where else can you get a giant salad for 2 euros??? Cucumber, lettuce, tomatoes, radishes, onions, herbs and a great dressing!!!
If you write reviews, you should arrive first, think about it and then start sawing off the chair leg.
My conclusion is that (apart from time management) everything is as it should be here. Holiday feeling, good-humored staff and we go home satisfied.
For me, a recommendation if you don't feel like local food.

terrible burgers.
Jan 2023 • Couples
went here on the 2nd of January. My girlfriend and i ordered two burgers. one chicken and one double cheese hobo.
one of the worst burgers I have ever had. the burger was one solid brown colour the whole way through. like it had been precooked and then reheated. the texture was that of cardboard and not a drop of juice in the burger. I was so hungry after having partied the night before that I ate it anyway. I was starving. I wasn't going to complain because I was just tired. 

my girlfriends chicken burger was wet. the bread was wet. the onions were wet. she had one bite and then decided not to eat it. 

half way through eating one of the staff asked if everything was okay. I said no and explained. they went and got the chef. I spoke to the chef and showed her the meat she had somehow turned into cardboard and asked if it was fresh and she insisted it was fresh. There is no way it was fresh. I've cooked hundreds of burger and they do not go one solid brown colour all the way through unless they have been precooked and then reheated to serve. we paid and left. 

the French fries were OK. and the orange juice I order was good too. 

we will never be returning to this restaurant. we've been to phu quoc many times before, and to this particular restaurant before, and had always had such a good experience. sad.
